heroTagline: I design and ship Flutter apps that feel fast, stay maintainable, and scale with real product needs — from Clean Architecture and Bloc to Firebase, REST, OCR, and AI-assisted features.
aboutParagraph1: I build mobile products end to end — clear architecture, reliable state management, and interfaces that stay calm under complexity. My work sits at the intersection of Clean Architecture, Bloc, cloud-backed data, and device capabilities like OCR, NFC, and biometrics.
aboutParagraph2: Based in Pakistan and open to remote collaboration worldwide. I communicate clearly with product and engineering teams, debug with discipline, and care about the details users actually feel.
